claude.sample_unit: clinical trial staff participants (316 observations; plus 263 retrospective and 884 prospective notes)
models_evaluated: agentic large language model system (configurations not specified)

links.outcome: Prospective silent-deployment detection F1 versus retrospective performance
links.effect: Retrospective detection macro-F1 0.92; prospective silent deployment over three months (884 notes) detection F1 was 0.72–0.79, revealing lower live-data performance
links.quote: In prospective silent deployment over three months (884 notes), detection F1 was 0.72–0.79.

links.outcome: Annotation time, accuracy, agreement for staff with vs without agentic AI assistance
links.effect: Randomized crossover (17 participants, 316 observations): time reduced 40% (P<0.001), complete-match accuracy OR 1.45 (95% CI 1.01–2.09; P=0.045), Krippendorff's α from 0.22–0.51 to 0.82–0.85
links.quote: In a randomized crossover study of clinical trial staff (17 participants, 316 observations), agentic assistance reduced annotation time by 40% (P < 0.001), increased complete-match accuracy (OR 1.45; 95% CI 1.01–2.09; P = 0.045), and improved inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff’s α from 0.22–0.51 to 0.82–0.85).

unlisted_practices: Self-consistency (repeated sampling/aggregation) to improve LLM extraction accuracy (F1 improved by 0.14)

openai.sample_unit: clinical trial staff participants in the randomized crossover phase

links.outcome: Staff annotation time, complete-match accuracy, and inter-annotator agreement with versus without agentic assistance
links.effect: Annotation time fell 40% (P < 0.001); complete-match accuracy increased (OR 1.45; 95% CI 1.01–2.09; P = 0.045); Krippendorff’s α improved from 0.22–0.51 to 0.82–0.85.
links.quote: In a randomized crossover study of clinical trial staff (17 participants, 316 observations), agentic assistance reduced annotation time by 40% (P < 0.001), increased complete-match accuracy (OR 1.45; 95% CI 1.01–2.09; P = 0.045), and improved inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff’s α from 0.22–0.51 to 0.82–0.85).

links.outcome: Prospective silent-deployment detection performance compared with retrospective performance
links.effect: Retrospective detection macro-averaged F1 was 0.92 (263 notes); prospective silent-deployment detection F1 was 0.72–0.79 over three months (884 notes).
links.quote: In prospective silent deployment over three months (884 notes), detection F1 was 0.72–0.79.

unlisted_practices: Use self-consistency to improve extraction performance; self-consistency improved F1 by 0.14.

links.effect: In prospective silent deployment over three months, the system achieved a detection F1 of 0.72 to 0.79.
